statement: let I := fun n : ℕ => Finset.Icc ((n+2)/3) ((2*n)/3); let P := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 2 z).filter Nat.Prime; let V := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)/n * ∏ p ∈ (P z).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ n), (1-2/(p:ℝ)); let Z₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, 64 ≤ N ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → |V n (Z₁ n) / V n n.sqrt - 9/4| ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: Farey 中心窗中，立方根截断与平方根截断的筛主项之比趋于 9/4。
plain_statement.en: The ratio of the central Farey sieve volumes at the cube-root and square-root cutoffs tends to 9/4.

brief.zh: 保留每个偶数 n 自身的坏素因子与两个取整端点。用 Mertens 素数倒数和估计处理中间素数，在取对数后的误差中分别控制整除 n 的素数与二次余项。该比值将 HD-8015 的末段损失预算归一化为 7/4 加趋零项。
brief.en: Keep the primes dividing the individual even target and both integer endpoints. Apply Mertens' reciprocal-prime estimate across the interval and bound separately the omitted divisors of n and the quadratic logarithm error. This gives 7/4 as the limiting terminal-scale budget for the late first-hit count.
